paragraphs_affected: § 184k StGB (NEW — Verletzung der Intimsphäre durch Bildaufnahmen; extends § 201a)
§ 201b StGB (NEW — Verletzung von Persönlichkeitsrechten durch täuschende Inhalte / non-sexual Deepfakes)
§ 202e StGB (NEW — Unbefugte Überwachung mittels Informations-/Kommunikationstechnik; extends § 238)
NetzDG § 3 (netzdg-3) — new Zustellungsbevollmächtigter duty for non-EU networks
highlights: BMJ 'Gesetz gegen digitale Gewalt' (GgdG) introduced 17 Apr 2026 by Justice Minister Hubig.
Three new StGB paragraphs (184k, 201b, 202e) cover pornographic/non-sexual Deepfakes, digital voyeurism and tech-enabled cyberstalking — core SafeVoice harassment scenarios currently unmapped.
NetzDG amended with a domestic-service-agent duty for non-EU platforms, strengthening the existing netzdg-3 platform-obligations entry.
Law is NOT yet in force: Referentenentwurf → parliamentary process; driven by EU Directive (EU) 2024/1385 (transposition deadline 14 Jun 2027).
SafeVoice schema (backend/app/database.py laws list + backend/app/data/mock_data.py GermanLaw objects) must add the 3 new paragraphs and update netzdg-3 before enactment.
